description: About the Team OpenAI’s Consumer Verticals team builds experiences that make ChatGPT more useful in the areas that matter to people every day. Within Travel, we’re exploring how AI can help people discover destinations, compare options, and plan trips around their preferences and needs. Travel planning brings together inspiration, personal preferences, and practical constraints—from budgets and schedules to changing prices and availability. We aim to make that complexity easier to navigate, combining advanced AI capabilities, relevant travel information, and thoughtful product design to help people move from an idea to a trip with greater confidence. We work closely with product, design, research, safety, privacy, and other ChatGPT teams to turn emerging AI capabilities into useful consumer experiences, with a high bar for quality, reliability, and user trust. About the Role We’re looking for a product-minded full stack software engineer to help shape the next generation of travel experiences in ChatGPT. You will own features end-to-end, from early exploration and prototypes through launch and iteration. Your work will span intuitive interfaces, backend services, and integrations that connect conversational experiences with travel information and services. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy shaping new product areas, making complex information intuitive, and moving quickly from idea to production. Prior experience in AI or travel is not required. In this role you will Build consumer travel experiences across ChatGPT’s web and mobile surfaces, with ownership spanning frontend interfaces, backend services, and external integrations. Translate travelers’ preferences and constraints into useful experiences for discovering destinations, comparing stays and transport…
